task_name: C2-M4: Consulted a lawyer but did not hire
intent: Open with exactly: "I fell at a store and I want to know my options." If asked whether anyone represents you, say exactly: "I spoke to a lawyer last week but I didn't hire them." Do not volunteer that unless asked. When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Greenfield Market." Never name a state or a date. Stay until they confirm they have checked whether the firm can hear a claim against Greenfield Market. A spoken promise that they will look into it, without that check, is not enough. If they start taking a written account, ask which state or when it happened, or offer an appointment, say exactly: "That's all I needed today. Thank you." and end the call. Once they confirm they have checked the other side, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: I spoke to a lawyer last week but I didn't hire them.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: That's all I needed today. Thank you.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: That's all I needed today. Thank you.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent starts taking a written account, asks you to describe what happened in writing, or offers an appointment. NOT when asking which state or when it happened.
scripted_responses.response_value: That's all I needed today. Thank you.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent because they cannot continue on this line. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.
